scripts.dev: dotenvx run -f .env.development -- vp exec vinext dev
scripts.build: dotenvx run -f .env.production -- vp exec vinext build
scripts.build:staging: dotenvx run -f .env.staging -- vp exec vinext build
scripts.start: npm run cf:devvars && dotenvx run -f .env.production -- vp exec wrangler dev --config dist/server/wrangler.json
scripts.deploy: dotenvx run -f .env.production -- vp exec vinext-cloudflare deploy --config dist/server/wrangler.json
scripts.deploy:staging: dotenvx run -f .env.staging -- vp exec vinext-cloudflare deploy --config dist/server/wrangler.json --env staging
scripts.cf:secrets: dotenvx get -f .env.production -ek DOTENV_PUBLIC_KEY_PRODUCTION | wrangler secret bulk --config dist/server/wrangler.json
scripts.cf:secrets:staging: dotenvx get -f .env.staging -ek DOTENV_PUBLIC_KEY_STAGING | wrangler secret bulk --config dist/server/wrangler.json --env staging
scripts.typegen: dotenvx run -f .env.development -- vp exec vinext typegen
